Implied hawkish Fed nomination impacting gold's attractiveness.
Significant drop in crude oil prices.

en.bull_case: Geopolitical instability or unexpected inflation spikes could drive safe-haven demand for gold, pushing prices higher.
en.bear_case: A hawkish Fed nomination leading to higher real rates or a stronger dollar would significantly depress gold prices.
